author: bubbycat
body:
Hi, I was banned October 16th, 2014. 2 Whole years ago. I was banned for hacking and I really love this server and I just want to play on the server again. I deleted all of my hacks right after I got banned on this server and ive waited 2 years to try and get back in. I was just wondering if there was any chance for me to get unbanned, You could put me on watch or something, I think ive learned to no longer hack because ive been punished for 2 years, My username is Bubbycat and I just really want to play on the server. I will no longer hack. Please almighty admin gods, spare me. This is actually serious and I really wanna be unbanned so please give me a chance, Thanks.


Again, Username: Bubbycat 

Please try and answer quick.
